first.text: Welcome to the Lantern & Thistle! Tobin Hale, at your service. Sit anywhere that isn't on fire. You've the look of travellers. What'll it be?

options.text: What have you got for sale?
We need a room for the night.
What have you got for sale?
We need a room for the night.
Father Anselm needs a lantern for the temple.

room.text: Five gold for a bed, a hot bath and Marta's stew in the morning. You'll wake up a new person. Probably the same person, but rested.

rested.text: There, colour back in your cheeks. The road will still be there, more's the pity.

news.text: News? The reeve's been tearing his hair out over a key he lost by the well. Old Wenna's run off her feet, the miller's wife has a fever. And Father Anselm up at the temple keeps asking after a proper lantern for his altar.

temple.text: The Temple of the Dawn, up the lane north-east of the square. Father Anselm will patch up the hurt for a small offering, and he says the dawn can even call back the fallen. I've never needed to find out, and I'd like to keep it that way.

pip.text: Pip Fairweather. Sings for his supper, and sometimes I even let him have it. Knows every tale in these hills and makes up the rest.

lantern.text: A lantern? I sell good hooded ones, five gold apiece. They're on the shelf behind me.
